Build the Root Shiny UI for CodingManageR

Source: R/app.R
coding_manager_ui.Rd

Constructs the top-level Bootstrap 5 / bslib page shell for CodingManageR, including browser language auto-detection, interactive spotlight tutorial assets, and the reactive page_content outlet that switches between the sign-in screen and the authenticated multi-tab workspace.

Usage

coding_manager_ui(lang = "de")

Arguments

lang

Default initial language code ("de" or "en"). Defaults to "de".

Value

A Shiny UI tag list suitable for shiny::shinyApp().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ui <- coding_manager_ui(lang = "en")
} # }
